digest.component_or_area: plan review gate / det_floor module split
propositions: det_floor.py exceeds 800-LOC hard cap (793 LOC) with only 7 lines headroom and requires splitting along the blocking vs never-blocking check concern boundary.

The four never-blocking checks (p2_resolution, p3_package_existence, p6_ac_quality, p7_destructive) form a closed call-graph cluster with zero edges to the retained checks, making them safely movable to det_advisory.py.

Module-object monkeypatch bindings in test_plan_review.py, test_af77_config_fault.py, and test_plan_review_prerequisites.py target only the retained half (DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, est_tokens), ensuring test patches continue reaching live code after the split.
p6_ac_quality's bare-name dependencies (vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, _verify_command_strings) must be declared at module level in det_advisory.py to resolve correctly after the move.
det_floor.py re-exports all four moved checks to preserve existing import points and attribute access patterns for backward compatibility.
The split produces det_floor.py ~566 LOC (29% headroom) and det_advisory.py ~303 LOC, both within the 200-500 target band, with no path-keyed registry artifacts requiring updates.
